title: Eleven Seasons and One Ground
subtitle: 四季节令 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 四季节令（自然生态·四季与节令）
meta: 主题语境：四季节令（自然生态·四季与节令）　|　核心词汇：season　|　正文 324 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 season 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandmother divided the year into ① seasons that matched nobody else's — eleven of them, by my count — and every ② season was named after what came out of the ground rather than what the calendar said. She said the calendar is a thing invented by people who do not grow anything, and that eleven is a truer number than four, which is the sentence my father quoted for the rest of his life.

The ③ dry season, which she called the waiting, ran from March to May, and she said the ④ season for arguing about water is always the one before the rain comes. The rain, when it arrived, was the second of her seasons and lasted eleven days, and she said nothing in the year tastes like the first week of it.

She would not eat anything ⑤ out of season, which in our house meant most of the year, and she said a thing eaten ⑥ in season tastes like the weather it grew in, and a thing eaten out of season tastes like nothing at all. For most of the year in our house that meant turnip, which she ate from October to March without complaint and without ever once cooking it for anybody else.

There were other seasons in the house that had nothing to do with the ground. My father's ⑦ football season ran from August to May, and she pretended not to notice it. My mother's ⑧ concert season — four concerts, eleven rehearsals — was the only one my grandmother asked about.

The village ⑨ tourist season, which she hated and which paid for eleven of us, began the week the schools broke up and ended with the first frost, which she said was the only honest season marker in the village. What she said about it, every year, was that a ⑩ season somebody else has named is not a season at all, and I have come to think she was right.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （一年的）时节；时令（the dry / rainy season）
D. n. （演出、电视的）演出季；一季
E. 固定搭配：in season 当令；应季
F. 固定搭配：out of season 不合时令；过季
G. 固定搭配：the season for ... ……的时节
H. n. 旺季；繁忙时期（the tourist season）

items.q: every season was named after what came out of the ground
The dry season, which she called the waiting
the season for arguing about water
a season somebody else has named

answers.why: seasons 意为“季节”，祖母把一年分成跟谁都不一样的季节，一共十一个。
season 意为“季节”，每个季节都以地里长出的东西命名，而不是按日历。
the dry season 意为“旱季”，她管它叫“等待”，从三月到五月。
the season for ... 意为“……的时节”，争水的时节总是在下雨之前。
out of season 意为“不合时令、过季”，她不吃任何不当令的东西。
in season 意为“当令、应季”，当令吃的东西有它生长时那个天气的味道。
football season 意为“足球赛季”，我父亲的赛季从八月持续到五月。
concert season 意为“演出季（音乐季）”，母亲一年四场音乐会、十一次排练。
the tourist season 意为“旅游旺季”，她讨厌旺季，可是一家人靠它养活。
a season 意为“季节”，她说由别人命名的季节根本不算季节。
